name: aaron_marketing_skills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the aaron_marketing_skills capability.

prompts.name: generate_strategy
prompts.template: Create a marketing strategy targeting {audience_data} to achieve {marketing_goal} using all seven disciplines.
prompts.use_case: Developing multi-channel marketing campaigns integrating AI-driven insights.

prompts.name: audit_content
prompts.template: Evaluate the following marketing content against the audit gates: {audit_criteria} and provide improvement suggestions.
prompts.use_case: Scaling marketing operations with AI-powered modular skill bots working across disciplines.

prompts.name: performance_report
prompts.template: Generate a performance report analyzing metrics from the latest campaign focused on {marketing_goal}.
prompts.use_case: Quality assurance and compliance auditing for marketing content.

prompts.name: optimize_channel
prompts.template: Recommend optimizations for the {channel_parameters} channel based on recent campaign outcomes.
prompts.use_case: Optimizing campaign performance via data-driven AI insights and audits.
